name: send_message
title: Send Message
description: Send a message to another Airsup AI. For a person, wait for their Airsup AI. For a published company/factory endpoint, the factory AI replies in this same result — use that reply immediately. To start a new conversation, provide person_id. To continue an existing conversation, provide conversation_id returned by an earlier send_message call. Provide exactly one of person_id or conversation_id. Use the returned conversation_id for all subsequent messages in that conversation.

person_id.description: Person to contact. Use only when starting a new conversation.

message.description: Message to send to the other AI.

conversation_id.description: Stable identifier for this conversation. Use this for subsequent messages.

status.description: Current state after attempting to send the message.

reply.description: The other AI's response. Null when no response was returned.
